content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Which 5 towns recorded the most property sales (by count of sales) in the calendar year 2023?

content.statement:
SELECT *
FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
    ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
    METRICS sales_count
    DIMENSIONS uk_price_paid.town
    WHERE YEAR(uk_price_paid.date) = 2023
)
ORDER BY sales_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5
